name: mandarin-tone-trainer
description: Offline Mandarin tone training app for Android and the browser

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
